name: pappcorn-plugins
description: PappCorn's plugin catalog for Claude — free open-source connectors plus licensed plugins.

plugins.name: gmail-mcp
plugins.description: Read, search, triage, draft and SEND email from your own Gmail account. Uses your own Google OAuth app — your credentials never leave your machine.

plugins.name: whatsapp-mcp
plugins.description: Send WhatsApp messages from your own number via Meta's official WhatsApp Cloud API. Outbound v1: templates and free-form replies inside the 24-hour window.

plugins.name: product-team
plugins.description: PappCorn's six-agent INSPIRED product team (product-manager, uiux-designer, coder, qa-tester, debugger, deployer) plus the dev-loop skills (triage, ship-issue, review-loop, issue-planner). Licensed plugin — installation requires granted read access to its repo. Request access: cris@pappcorn.com.
